6.02 Sickness Payments Prior to Eligibility for Short Term Disability. (Also see Appendix C, Part XI)

A. Payment for full or partial days scheduled but not worked due to personal illness during the first seven (7) consecutive days prior to eligibility for payments under short term disabilitywill be paid on the following basis:

1. Employees hired prior to 8/9/2015

<table border=1><tr><td>Completed Seniority within the calendar year</td><td>Unpaid waiting period</td><td>Maximum paid days in a calendar year*</td></tr><tr><td>Prior to 3 years</td><td>2</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td>3 years but less than 6 years</td><td>None</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td>6 years but less than 11 years</td><td>None</td><td>7</td></tr><tr><td>11 years but less than 25 years</td><td>None</td><td>10</td></tr><tr><td>25 years &amp; over</td><td>None</td><td>None</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">* The maximum number of paid days may be converted to an equivalent number of hours based on the employee&#x27;s normal scheduled daily tour.</td></tr></table>

2. Employees hired on or after 8/9/2015

<table border=1><tr><td>Completed Seniority within the calendar year</td><td>Unpaid waiting period</td><td>Maximum paid days in a calendar year*</td></tr><tr><td>Prior to 3 years</td><td>2</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td>3 years &amp; over</td><td>None</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">* The maximum number of paid days may be converted to an equivalent number of hours based on the employee&#x27;s normal scheduled daily tour.</td></tr></table>

3. Employees shall receive pay at the regular rate for scheduled time not worked on the day they become sick or return to work in accordance with 6.02A.
